sources.cost_floor: SemiAnalysis AI-Cloud TCO model (Aug-10-2026), Full TCO row 147, Neocloud Giant profile; VR = NVL72 2300W variant

economics._source: Koen's PAYG_GPU_CPU_Pricing_Portfolio_2026-09-07_v5.xlsx (OneDrive, synced copy modified 2026-09-14), sheet Economics rows 6-10 / 36-59 / 503-510; capital components from Finance GPU Calculator (source S008), cash components Rent/Electricity/Other/US taxes/Bandwidth/Deliveries/Pers Costs; period 2026-08-31.
economics._method: Cash-recovery basis, no depreciation. floor_Nm = (capex_per_gpu / N + cash_opex_per_installed_hour * 744) / (730 * occupancy). Occupancy default 0.75 (a sensitivity assumption, not current PAYG utilisation). Payback at a price p and occupancy u = capex_per_gpu / (p * 730 * u - cash_opex_per_installed_hour * 744) months. GB200 / GB300 / VR are not in the portfolio workbook (no PAYG); only the SemiAnalysis modeled cost floor exists for them.
